environment.description: Same Go Gin application deployed on ECS Fargate connecting to Amazon RDS PostgreSQL 15 via PgBouncer in transaction mode. The database role 'app_restricted' has RLS FORCE enabled. PostgreSQL configuration: ALTER TABLE documents ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY; ALTER TABLE documents FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY; CREATE POLICY tenant_isolation ON documents USING (tenant_id = current_setting('app.current_tenant')); The PgBouncer pool is configured with server_reset_query = 'DISCARD ALL' and application_name_add_host = 1. However, because PgBouncer in transaction mode issues DISCARD ALL between transactions, the SET app.current_tenant command issued via db.Exec() is discarded before the subsequent db.Query() executes on a potentially different server connection. When current_setting('app.current_tenant') is unset (empty string after DISCARD ALL), the RLS policy evaluates tenant_id = '' which matches NO rows, causing all queries to return empty results rather than cross-tenant data. The FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY ensures the policy applies even to the table owner.

config.database: RDS PostgreSQL 15, role 'app_restricted' with FORCE RLS
config.rls_policy: CREATE POLICY tenant_isolation ON documents USING (tenant_id = current_setting('app.current_tenant', true)); current_setting with missing_ok=true returns empty string when unset
config.rls_force: ALTER TABLE documents FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY applied to app_restricted role
config.network: Private subnet, ALB with mTLS termination
